summary: Frontend testing completed for GPS Flow Mode features. 7/9 features working correctly. Found 2 critical bugs: 1) gpsFlowMode not set when clicking waypoint button, 2) handleAnalyzeGPS function is undefined.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking waypoint button does NOT set gpsFlowMode=true, so 'FLUX EN DIRECT' badge and 'Mode flux dynamique actif' text don't appear in GPS Analysis panel
ui_bugs.fix: Add setGpsFlowMode(true) in the onClick handler when newState is truthy

ui_bugs.issue: handleAnalyzeGPS() function is called but never defined - causes runtime error
ui_bugs.fix: Define handleAnalyzeGPS function or replace with existing analysis function like calculateProbability()
